title: First Meeting — Project Kickoff
discussed:
Brief summary of the main points discussed:

• Mention of Richard Feynman and the idea that simulating nature is best done using nature itself.
• NISQ+ era and its potential applications.
• Concept of LOCC.
• Challenge of the Barren Plateau problem, where training becomes harder as qubit count increases.
• Mention of NVIDIA Quantum DGX as a hybrid quantum-classical platform.
• The Coming Wave (reference/material)

Potential application areas:
• Reinforcement Learning with NISQ+ for molecular-related problems
• Electronic structure problems and molecular-level design

Quantum software/tools discussed:
• PennyLane
• Qiskit
• Xanadu tools/platforms

Additional resources:
• Scientific American
• Egyptian Knowledge Bank
• Summer schools and learning opportunities

title: Second Meeting — Quantum RL & Project Direction
discussed:
Discussion Points:
• Overview of QRL and quantum state preparation.
• Agent–environment configurations: Classical–Quantum (CQ) and Quantum–Quantum (QQ)
• Relationship between Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Quantum Simulation.
• Quantum simulators are used to simulate physical systems (e.g., molecules and many-body systems), not necessarily quantum computers themselves.
• Importance of many-body systems in physics, material science, and computational chemistry.

References Mentioned:
• What's a Quantum Computer Good For Anyway? (Scientific American)
• Fundamentals of Physics (highlighted sections)
• Reinforcement Learning for Quantum Technology
• RL-Assisted Quantum Simulation of Many-Body Systems (arXiv)
• Quantum Simulation + RL paper (18 May 2026)
• arXiv: 2601.18953
• Physical Review A, Vol. 112
• RL-CSE GitHub (Jiaji Zhang)
• ML-CQE GitHub

Proposed Project Direction:
Develop a tool that combines Quantum Simulation and Reinforcement Learning, where an RL agent assists in simulating and optimizing complex physical systems, particularly quantum many-body systems and applications in computational chemistry.

actionItems.text: Explore RL-CSE and ML-CQE GitHub repos
Define project scope combining QRL + Quantum Simulation
Research many-body systems in computational chemistry
